entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Through:
 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Ms. Justice Rekha Palli
 Order
% 20.04.2023

CM APPL. 19467/2023 -Ex 1. Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The application stands disposed of.

The present appeal preferred by the claimant under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 seeks enhancement of compensation awarded by the learned Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal vide the impugned award dated 08.08.2022.

4. Taking into account that no recovery rights have been granted under the impugned award, no notice is required to be issued to the respondent nos.1 & 2.
5.
Upon the appellant taking steps, issue notice to the respondent no.3 through all permissible modes.
6. Reply, if any, be filed within six weeks.
Rejoinder thereto, if any, be filed within four weeks thereafter.
7. The TCR be requisitioned and digitized before the next date.

8. List on 16.10.2023.
